note: Winneshiek County Conservation park off Hwy 24 between Calmar and Fort Atkinson, on 33-acre Lake Meyer. The campground is two wooded loops at the park's southwest corner, with a timber-frame shelter, playground and ball diamond; boat ramp, fishing jetty and kayak launch at the lake's east end. Electric-motor boating, no swimming, hiking trails. Firewood from outside Winneshiek County not allowed; local firewood sold on site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 electric (FCFS), 50-amp at some sites, no water hookups, showers, flush and pit toilets, dump, drinking water. Changed sites 35->32 (28 electric + 4 non-electric) and lake 38->33 acres. Lakeview downgrade proposed (wooded loops ~115 m from the lake). Pin is ~650 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD: lakeview -> not waterfront (unsure, so downgrade). The county overview map puts the campground in the park's southwest corner. Imagery shows its two loops in mature woods. The nearest sites (the northeast loop, 8-14) are ~110-120 m from the north and east shores through continuous forest, with no clearing toward the water. The county's campground photo shows a wooded gravel loop with no water in view, and no page claims a lake view from the sites.
PIN MOVE: stored 43.17380,-91.90420 is the east-end boat launch and parking lot, ~650 m east of the campground. Corrected: 43.1733,-91.9119 (centre of the camp loops, by the shower house).
SITES: the stored count of 35 (from the old note's '27 electric + 8 non-electric') is replaced by the county's '28 electric, 4 non-electric'. The layout PDF also shows a separate 'Tent Sites' spur.
SEASON: no campground opening or closing dates are posted, only 'closed for the season' as of 10/26/26. The note's '~Apr-Oct' was dropped as unsourced; stored year_round false is left as it is.
Website and phone (563) 534-7145 confirmed. The website field also lists mycountyparks.com first; the county's own winneshiekwild.com page is the better primary.
